died.name: Héloïse
died.desc: French nun, philosopher, writer, scholar and abbess
died.last_words: In death at last let me rest with Abelard.

died.name: Frederick William, Duke of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel
died.cause: to his aide Major von Wachholtz asking for whereabouts of adjutant-general Elias Olfermann shortly after being shot in the liver at the Battle of Quatre Bras
died.last_words: My dear Wachholtz, where is Olfermann?

died.name: Joseph Fourier
died.cause: calling to his physician, who had stepped out of the room
died.last_words: Quick, quick! some vinegar! I am fainting.

died.name: Felicia Hemans
died.last_words: I feel as if I were sitting with Mary at the feet of my Redeemer, hearing the music of his voice, and learning of Him to be meek and lowly.

died.name: Jim Henson
died.last_words: See you later, I feel like I'm in good hands.

born.name: William H. Seward
born.cause: when asked if he had any final words

born.name: Philip Danforth Armour
born.desc: American industrialist, founder of Armour and Company
born.last_words: I am not afraid to die.
